title: Neuralink says it got FDA approval for the LINK Pivotal Study, a US clinical trial to evaluate the safety and effectiveness of its BCI system in ALS patients (Craig Trudell/Bloomberg)
summary: Craig Trudell / Bloomberg: Neuralink says it got FDA approval for the LINK Pivotal Study, a US clinical trial to evaluate the safety and effectiveness of its BCI system in ALS patients — Elon Musk's startup Neuralink received US approval to start what it's calling a pivotal trial for its brain-computer implants.
